content.about: Mauritius is an island country in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar. It is surrounded by coral reefs and has a mountainous centre. Its people have Indian, African, Chinese and European roots. The dodo bird lived only here.

standout.text: Mauritius was the only home of the dodo, which became extinct in the 1600s.

didYouKnow: The Seven Coloured Earths are sand dunes of different colours.
An underwater "waterfall" illusion appears off Le Morne.
